unit: Etnachta phrase group, contemporary instructional performances credited to Sinai Temple. Not an isolated note or an ancient performance.
test: Compare corresponding sign occurrences after score alignment; phrase duration or file inequality alone cannot establish melodic difference.
method: Mono 16 kHz, 20 ms RMS windows, threshold 5% of file peak RMS. Reported span includes internal pauses. These whole-clip measurements cannot be assigned to the terminal accent.
